mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.food_id) FROM food_daily_visit v INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = v.food_id AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE v.user_id = #{userId}) AS viewed_food_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_favorite favorite INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = favorite.food_id AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE favorite.user_id = #{userId}) AS favorite_count
